items.title: Burke Stevenson Interview, 1959-06-12
items.q: I've heard of that. As well as Humphrey, a grandfather.

ctx.x: Was that a band that Charlie Love, that Charlie Love, his father played too, didn't he? No, that wasn't a band Charlie Love.

No, that wasn't a band Charlie Love. No, that wasn't a band Charlie Love. Well, this band, my father played in, they had a professor by the name of Jim Humphrey, used to teach him. Oh, yeah, I've heard of that. As well as Humphrey, a grandfather. Yeah. He used to come out there in the country, that we used in the country at the time, a place by the name of Dair Range, Dair Range Plantation.
Well, that was down for Jim Robinson and Sonny Henry.
